title: A Simple Baseline for Streaming Video Understanding
task: Streaming video understanding with efficient context usage
key_results: SimpleStream with 4 recent frames achieves 67.7% on OVO-Bench and 80.59% on StreamingBench, matching or exceeding complex memory-based approaches
comments: The finding challenges the assumption that more context always improves performance; reveals an important perception-memory trade-off that should inform future benchmark design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex memory mechanisms are necessary for strong streaming video understanding
hypotheses.result: Refuted: simple sliding-window baseline matches published methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Value of longer context increases uniformly with model scale
hypotheses.result: Refuted: context benefit is backbone-dependent

title: Self-Distilled RLVR
task: Improving LLM training stability by combining self-distillation with reinforcement learning
key_results: RLSD achieves higher convergence ceiling and superior training stability compared to pure RLVR or on-policy self-distillation
comments: The insight that privileged information causes information leakage is important; hybrid approach using self-distillation only for fine-grained magnitudes while RLVR provides directions is pragmatic.

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy self-distillation alone provides stable learning signals for LLMs
hypotheses.result: Refuted: causes information leakage and instability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining self-distillation for magnitudes with RLVR for directions improves training
hypotheses.result: Supported: achieves better convergence and stability

title: Token Warping Helps MLLMs Look from Nearby Viewpoints
task: Viewpoint change robustness in multimodal models via token warping
key_results: Token-level backward warping consistently outperforms pixel-wise warping, fine-tuned models, and generative approaches on ViewBench
comments: Applying geometric transformations at token level rather than pixel level is elegant and grounded in cognitive theory of mental imagery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Token-level warping provides better geometric stability for viewpoint changes than pixel-wise warping
hypotheses.result: Supported: backward token warping outperforms all baselines

title: Agentic-MME: What Agentic Capability Really Brings to Multimodal Intelligence?
task: Evaluating multimodal agentic capabilities with process-level verification
key_results: Best model (Gemini3-pro) achieves 56.3% overall accuracy, dropping to 23.0% on Level-3 tasks; benchmark contains 418 tasks with 2,000+ stepwise checkpoints
comments: Process-verified evaluation with fine-grained intermediate states is more rigorous than answer-only metrics and reveals significant performance gaps on realistic problems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current MLLMs can effectively integrate visual and knowledge tools for real-world tasks
hypotheses.result: Partially unsupported: only 56.3% overall, 23% on hardest tasks

title: Communicating about Space: Language-Mediated Spatial Integration Across Partial Views
task: Evaluating MLLMs' ability to build shared spatial understanding through dialogue across egocentric views
key_results: Gemini-3-Pro-Thinking achieves 72% accuracy vs. human 95%; models fail at globally consistent maps (near chance); thinking helps anchor grounding but not higher-level reasoning
comments: The finding that models explore new possibilities rather than converge on shared mental models suggests fundamental differences from human collaborative reasoning beyond raw accuracy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MLLMs can align egocentric views through dialogue to form allocentric mental models
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; models succeed at anchor identification but fail at global map consistency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thinking capability improves spatial communication across all reasoning levels
hypotheses.result: Rejected for higher-level reasoning; thinking only helps anchor grounding

title: Test-Time Scaling Makes Overtraining Compute-Optimal
task: Joint optimization of model size, training tokens, and test-time sampling under fixed computational budget
key_results: Optimal pretraining shifts into overtraining regime when accounting for inference cost; validated by training heavily overtrained models with substantially stronger performance than standard scaling
comments: This challenges conventional wisdom that Chinchilla-optimal models are best, revealing a critical oversight in modern LLM deployment economics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimal pretraining compute allocation is independent of inference costs
hypotheses.result: Rejected; inference cost fundamentally changes optimal allocation strategy

hypotheses.hypothesis: T^2 scaling law predictions survive post-training stage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across experiments

title: InCoder-32B-Thinking: Industrial Code World Model for Thinking
task: Code reasoning for industrial software with hardware-aware world modeling
key_results: 81.3% on LiveCodeBench v5, 84.0% on CAD-Coder, 38.0% on KernelBench; top-tier open-source performance across domains
comments: Domain-specific world model trained on execution traces is novel; validation through actual toolchains ensures reasoning traces match real problem-solving depth.

model_io.model: InCoder-32B with Error-driven Chain-of-Thought + Industrial Code World Model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Industrial code reasoning requires domain-specific world models beyond general LLM pretraining
hypotheses.result: Supported: ICWM enables self-verification and domain-specific benchmarks

title: Swift-SVD: Theoretical Optimality Meets Practical Efficiency in Low-Rank LLM Compression
task: Training-free, theoretically optimal low-rank compression of LLMs via SVD with practical efficiency
key_results: Achieves 3-70X speedups in compression time while matching theoretical optimality; outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across six LLMs and eight datasets
comments: The dynamic rank allocation strategy using effective rank is elegant, but the practical speedup range is quite wide—suggesting variable efficiency gains depending on model/dataset.

model_io.model: SVD-based compression with activation-aware covariance aggregation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Closed-form eigenvalue decomposition on aggregated covariance achieves theoretical optimality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with numerical stability guarantees

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic rank allocation improves end-to-end compression vs. uniform rank allocation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across experiments

title: AgentSocialBench: Evaluating Privacy Risks in Human-Centered Agentic Social Networks
task: Evaluating privacy risks in human-centered agentic social networks
key_results: Privacy risks fundamentally harder than single-agent settings; abstraction paradox: privacy instructions increase sensitive information discussion; leakage persists despite explicit protection instructions
comments: The abstraction paradox is particularly concerning—agents taught to abstract actually discuss sensitive info more—suggesting counterintuitive failure modes in multi-agent coordination.

model_io.model: Multi-agent LLM systems with social network structure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privacy preservation in multi-agent social networks follows similar principles as single-agent privacy
hypotheses.result: Refuted: cross-domain/cross-user coordination creates persistent leakage pressure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teaching agents to abstract sensitive information improves privacy
hypotheses.result: Refuted: abstraction paradox shows this paradoxically increases discussion

title: AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
task: Evaluating safety of computer-use agents against accumulated harmful behavior
key_results: Claude Code with Qwen3-Coder exhibits 73.63% attack success rate; benchmark contains 2,653 instances with locally legitimate but jointly unsafe sequences
comments: Key insight is that intermediate steps can be individually benign yet collectively lead to harm—a failure mode distinct from single-turn safety vulnerabilities.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model alignment alone ensures safety of autonomous computer-use agents
hypotheses.result: Refuted: 73.63% attack success rate indicates alignment insufficient

title: Xpertbench: Expert Level Tasks with Rubrics-Based Evaluation
task: Evaluating expert-level reasoning across professional domains with rubric-based assessment
key_results: Peak success rate ~66% across leading models; mean score ~55%; significant drop in performance on open-ended tasks despite closure on standard benchmarks
comments: ShotJudge with expert few-shot exemplars is a clever mitigation for self-reward bias; the expert-gap finding is significant for understanding current AI limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current LLMs achieve strong performance on expert-level professional tasks
hypotheses.result: Refuted: peak 66% success, 55% mean indicates significant expert-gap

title: Salt: Self-Consistent Distribution Matching with Cache-Aware Training for Fast Video Generation
task: Distilling video generation models to extremely low inference budgets (2-4 NFEs) via self-consistent distribution matching with cache-aware training
key_results: SC-DMD consistently improves low-NFE video generation quality across non-autoregressive and autoregressive backbones; compatible with diverse KV-cache memory mechanisms
comments: The cache-conditioned feature alignment is a practical contribution, though specific numerical improvements over baselines are not stated in the abstract.

model_io.model: Video generation model with distribution matching distillation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trajectory-style consistency distillation alone cannot prevent drift under complex video dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SC-DMD with explicit composition regularization needed

hypotheses.hypothesis: KV cache quality can be parameterized as a conditioning variable in training
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via cache-distribution-aware training improvements

title: CoME-VL: Scaling Complementary Multi-Encoder Vision-Language Learning
task: Scaling complementary multi-encoder fusion for vision-language understanding
key_results: Average improvement of 4.9% on visual understanding and 5.4% on grounding tasks; state-of-the-art on RefCOCO detection
comments: Fusion of contrastive (CLIP) and self-supervised (DINO) encoders is well-motivated; entropy-guided aggregation with orthogonality constraints elegantly reduces redundancy.

model_io.model: CoME-VL (fusion of CLIP encoder + DINO encoder)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single contrastive vision encoder is optimal for vision-language modeling
hypotheses.result: Refuted: complementary multi-encoder fusion achieves consistent improvements

title: Do World Action Models Generalize Better than VLAs? A Robustness Study
task: Comparative robustness evaluation of vision-language-action policies vs. world action models for robot planning under visual and language perturbations
key_results: WAMs achieve strong robustness (LingBot-VA 74.2% on RoboTwin 2.0-Plus, Cosmos-Policy 82.2% on LIBERO-Plus); VLAs require extensive diverse training for comparable robustness
comments: The finding that hybrid approaches show intermediate robustness suggests video-based dynamic priors need careful integration rather than simple addition to language models.

model_io.model: VLA policies (π_0.5, etc.) and WAMs (LingBot-VA, Cosmos-Policy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: World action models generalize better than VLAs due to web-scale video pretraining and explicit dynamic prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0-Plus with various perturbations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid approaches combining video priors with language models outperform both pure VLAs and WAMs
hypotheses.result: Rejected; hybrids show only intermediate robustness, highlighting integration challenges

title: OGT mediates O-GlcNAcylation of MEIS2 and affects palatal osteogenic development
task: Define O-GlcNAcylation of MEIS2 by OGT in regulating palatal osteogenic development
key_results: Decreased O-GlcNAc levels in atRA-induced cleft palate mice; OGT deletion or O-GlcNAc loss elevated cleft palate prevalence and compromised bone formation; MEIS2 Ser237 identified as critical O-GlcNAcylation site; O-GlcNAcylation stabilizes MEIS2 via ubiquitination inhibition
comments: PTM-mediated regulation of transcription factor stability is well-mechanized, but tissue-specific OGT contribution (epithelial vs. mesenchymal) and therapeutic targeting remain unclear.

model_io.model: Zebrafish and mouse models with OGT/MEIS2 manipulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: O-GlcNAcylation of MEIS2 at Ser237 by OGT protects palatal osteogenic development via inhibition of ubiquitin-mediated degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; O-GlcNAc loss or OGT deletion impairs bone development and increases cleft palate; MEIS2 O-GlcNAcylation maintains stability

title: Programmed cell death in cancer: targeting necroptosis to kill tumor cell
task: Review necroptosis mechanisms and therapeutic strategies for tumor cell death and anti-tumor immunity
key_results: RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL-mediated necroptosis induces immunogenic cell death in tumor cells; dual role as tumor suppressor (via ICD and immune activation) and promoter (via inflammation); emerging therapies via small molecules, natural products, and nanomedicines
comments: Comprehensive mechanistic review acknowledging context-dependent dual roles, but limited discussion of resistance mechanisms and biomarker discovery for patient stratification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Necroptosis induction in tumor cells can overcome chemotherapy resistance and enhance anti-tumor immunity
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; evidence supports ICD and immune activation, but tumor-promoting inflammatory effects limit therapeutic application

title: Cochlear nucleus spatial transcriptomes of normal and hearing loss mice reveal a critical role of Spp1 in bushy cells
task: Generate comprehensive cochlear nucleus transcriptomic atlas and identify Spp1-expressing bushy cells as hearing loss-responsive
key_results: Single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomics revealed comprehensive CN cell type atlas and hearing loss-induced gene expression changes; Spp1-expressing bushy cells primary CN type altered by hearing loss; Spp1 deletion affected auditory signal processing
comments: Multi-omic spatial approach provides valuable reference atlas, but functional validation of Spp1's role beyond signal processing (e.g., compensatory plasticity) and its therapeutic potential for hearing restoration is preliminary.

model_io.model: Cochlear nucleus of normal and congenital hearing loss mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spp1-expressing bushy cells in cochlear nucleus undergo hearing loss-induced transcriptomic changes critical for auditory processing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Spp1 deletion affects CN signal processing; Spp1 identified as hearing loss-responsive gene in bushy cell subtype

title: Non-necroptotic MLKL function damages mitochondria and promotes hematopoietic stem cell aging
task: Define non-necroptotic MLKL function in mitochondrial damage and hematopoietic stem cell aging
key_results: RIPK3-MLKL axis activated by inflammation and replication stress; activated MLKL accumulates in HSC mitochondria without causing necroptosis; impairs HSC self-renewal and lymphoid differentiation; reduces glycolytic flux during aging
comments: Reveals necroptosis-independent mitochondrial damage role of MLKL with clear aging relevance, but mechanism of MLKL translocation to mitochondria and interaction with mitochondrial proteins undefined.

model_io.model: HSCs in aging and stress models with MLKL manipulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-necroptotic MLKL activation impairs HSC function via mitochondrial damage during stress and aging
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MLKL accumulation in mitochondria correlates with reduced self-renewal, impaired differentiation, and mitochondrial dysfunction

title: Comprehensive CRISPR/Cas9-based mutagenesis identifies single-amino acid substitutions that abrogate SPEN function in X inactivation
task: Identify functional SPEN residues critical for Xist RNA-mediated X chromosome inactivation via systematic base editing
key_results: CRISPR/Cas9-mediated base editing screen identified SPEN RRM4-residue W522 substitution abrogates X-linked gene repression and impairs H3K27me3 deposition; screening in haploid cells efficient for recessive mutations
comments: Elegant methodology for single amino acid mapping of protein function, but mechanistic basis for W522-mediated Xist interaction and H3K27me3 recruitment remains uncharacterized.

model_io.model: CRISPR/Cas9 base editing screen in mouse ESCs

hypotheses.hypothesis: SPEN RRM4-residue W522 is critical for Xist RNA-mediated transcriptional repression and H3K27me3 establishment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; W522 substitution abrogates X-linked gene silencing and H3K27me3 deposition

title: VPS26A retromer complex and SNX27 mediate stress-induced Golgi bypass of membrane proteins
task: Identify molecular regulators of Golgi-independent protein secretion under stress
key_results: VPS26A retromer complex and SNX27 mediate unconventional secretion of ∆F508-CFTR and SARS-CoV-2 spike protein; SNX27 recruits cargo to VPS26A-VPS35-VPS29 retromer complex
comments: Reveals a previously unrecognized stress-response trafficking mechanism for disease-relevant proteins, though the structural basis of SNX27-retromer-cargo recognition remains unexplored.

model_io.model: CRISPR knockout screen in mammalian cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: VPS26A-retromer complex and SNX27 regulate Golgi-bypass trafficking of ∆F508-CFTR
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; retromer-SNX27 interaction necessary for UPS under stress

title: Effect of nanoliposomal gamma-oryzanol on cryosurvival, oxidative balance, and fertility of frozen–thawed ram spermatozoa
task: Optimize cryopreservation of ram sperm using nanoliposomal gamma-oryzanol to improve fertility outcomes
key_results: 100 µM GO-N treatment increased post-thaw motility (70.45%), membrane integrity (75.76%), reduced DNA fragmentation (17.22%), elevated mitochondrial potential (66.11%), and improved pregnancy/lambing rates compared to controls
comments: Comprehensive sperm quality assessment with reproductive validation is strong, but the mechanism of nanoparticle uptake and localization in spermatozoa remains unaddressed.

model_io.model: Ram sperm cryopreservation with GO/GO-N supplementation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nanoliposomal gamma-oryzanol at 100 µM optimally protects sperm quality during cryopreservation by reducing oxidative stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improved motility, integrity, and fertility metrics with lowest MDA and highest antioxidant enzyme activity

title: Royal jelly attenuates DMBA induced preneoplastic lesions in rat mammary gland and Skin
task: Evaluate royal jelly attenuation of DMBA-induced preneoplastic lesions via antioxidant and anti-apoptotic mechanisms
key_results: Royal jelly co-treatment normalized mammary gland histology, restored GPx/SOD levels to control, reduced MDA and p53/Bax expression, increased Bcl2; mitigated necrosis and reduced proliferation in skin
comments: Comprehensive biomarker analysis shows protective antioxidant effects, but the active compound(s) responsible and dose-response relationship in humans remain uncharacterized.

model_io.model: DMBA-induced carcinogenesis rat model with RJ supplementation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Royal jelly mitigates DMBA-induced oxidative stress and apoptosis in mammary gland and skin via antioxidant mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RJ co-treatment restored antioxidant enzymes and suppressed pro-apoptotic markers

title: Network pharmacology analysis and experimental validation of the gastric cancer-related targets of harmine
task: Identify HSP90AA1 as molecular target of harmine and characterize multi-target anti-gastric cancer mechanism
key_results: Harmine inhibited GC cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and induced apoptosis; HSP90AA1 identified as key target via network pharmacology and molecular docking; HSP90AA1 knockdown suppressed migration and invasion; moderate binding affinity confirmed by SPR/MST
comments: Multi-omics integration is comprehensive, but lack of dose-response analysis and in vivo efficacy data limits clinical translatability assessment.

model_io.model: GC cell lines with harmine treatment and HSP90AA1 manipulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Harmine exerts anti-GC effects via HSP90AA1 targeting and multi-target regulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; HSP90AA1 knockdown recapitulates harmine effects on migration/invasion; combined treatment shows additive effects on migration

title: Pioneering ultrastructural texture analysis of dendrites in the cerebellar dentate nucleus: an experimental rat model of hyperthermia-induced seizures
task: Characterize ultrastructural dendritic damage in hyperthermia-induced seizure model
key_results: Transmission electron microscopy revealed distinctive 'dark dendrite' aponecrosis with shrunken homogeneous dendroplasm in cerebellar dentate nucleus; morphometric analysis showed microtubule and organelle disintegration correlating with seizure phenotype
comments: Qualitative ultrastructural observations are thorough but lack quantitative morphometric data (dendrite diameter, mitochondrial density) needed to establish definitive correlations with seizure severity.

model_io.model: Rat hyperthermia-induced seizure model (young Wistar rats)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hyperthermic stress induces aponecrotic dendritic damage via microtubule disintegration in cerebellar dentate nucleus
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; electron microscopy shows 'dark dendrites' with compromised cytoskeletal architecture

title: Phosphotyrosine proteomics reveals novel Zap70 and Itk pathway targets downstream of TCR and CAR in Jurkat T cells
task: Map Zap70 and Itk kinase-controlled phosphotyrosine signaling networks in TCR and CAR T cell activation
key_results: LC-MS/MS identified complete TCR pathway downregulation by Zap70 inhibitor RDN (vs. incomplete by Itk inhibitor Soq); novel noncanonical phosphotyrosine sites responsive to RDN and Soq; RDN more complete inhibition of T cell signaling
comments: Comprehensive phosphoproteomics mapping is valuable, but functional validation of novel pY sites and their roles in T cell outcomes is limited.

model_io.model: Jurkat T cells with TCR/CAR stimulation and kinase inhibition

hypotheses.hypothesis: Zap70 and Itk control distinct canonical and noncanonical phosphotyrosine signaling pathways in T cell activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RDN provides more complete TCR pathway inhibition; novel pY sites identified downstream of each kinase

title: Upregulated TRPM1 is associated with apoptosis in Rs1 knockout mice and in ARPE19 cells through increased intracellular calcium
task: Elucidate TRPM1-mediated retinal apoptosis in retinoschisin deficiency via calcium signaling
key_results: TRPM1 upregulation 1.3-fold in Rs1-KO retinas and 2-fold in TRPM1-overexpressing ARPE19 cells; TRPM1-mediated calcium influx promoted CAMKII phosphorylation; increased P62/LC3B and BAX, decreased BCL2
comments: Mechanistic link between TRPM1-calcium-CAMKII-autophagy-apoptosis is plausible but relies on correlative evidence; direct causality of CAMKII in apoptosis pathway not definitively established.

model_io.model: Rs1-KO mice retina and TRPM1-overexpressing ARPE19 cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: TRPM1 upregulation in Rs1-deficient retinas promotes apoptosis via calcium-CAMKII-mediated autophagy and apoptotic signaling
hypotheses.result: Supported; TRPM1 overexpression increases calcium influx, CAMKII phosphorylation, autophagy markers, and pro-apoptotic proteins

title: Hypertonicity-induced RNF183 targets NKCC1 to protect kidney collecting duct cells but induces apoptosis in colon cells
task: Define RNF183-mediated NKCC1 ubiquitination in stress adaptation vs. disease pathogenesis
key_results: RNF183 promotes K63-linked ubiquitination and lysosomal degradation of NKCC1; RNF183 knockout increases hypertonic-induced caspase-3 cleavage in mIMCD-3 cells; overexpression induces apoptosis in Caco-2 cells
comments: The tissue-specific opposing effects (protective in kidney, pro-apoptotic in colon) suggest context-dependent regulation of ion homeostasis, but mechanistic basis for differential cell-type responses remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: RNF183-mediated NKCC1 ubiquitination protects kidney collecting duct cells under hypertonic stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in mIMCD-3 cells; RNF183 knockout increases cell death

hypotheses.hypothesis: RNF183 overexpression causes apoptosis in cells lacking endogenous RNF183 expression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in Caco-2 cells; elevated caspase-3 activation and disrupted Na+ homeostasis

title: autoFISH: a modular toolbox for sequential single-molecule RNA FISH experiments
task: Develop affordable automated platform for single-molecule RNA FISH with scalable spatial transcriptomics
key_results: autoFISH platform demonstrates reproducibility across multiple cell types and tissue preparations with optimized tissue-clearing protocol preserving nuclear structures; significantly reduced cost and technical expertise requirements
comments: Democratizing access to spatial transcriptomics is valuable, but the paper lacks quantitative performance metrics (e.g., resolution, sensitivity) compared to commercial systems.

title: Extracellular vesicles derived from senescent hepatocytes drive pan-cancer metastasis in aging
task: Identify senescent hepatocyte-derived EV miRNAs promoting pan-cancer metastasis in aging
key_results: Aged liver exhibits elevated P2RX7 and EV biogenesis; EV-encapsulated miR-25, miR-92a, miR-30c, miR-30d enhance tumor invasiveness; targeting senescence (dasatinib+quercetin), P2RX7, or silencing EV-miRNAs reduce metastasis in aged mice; reduced PTEN/LATS2 in older patient metastases
comments: Mechanistic link from senescence to metastasis is well-established, but the specificity of miRNA-target interactions in metastatic vs. primary tumors and tissue-type dependencies remain incompletely characterized.

model_io.model: Aging mouse tumor models and aged hepatocyte-derived EVs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Senescent hepatocyte-derived EVs promote pan-cancer metastasis in aging via EV-miRNA delivery and PTEN/LATS2 silencing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; EV-miRNAs enhance invasiveness and metastasis; senescence targeting and miRNA silencing reduce metastatic burden

title: CellLoop: Identifying single-cell 3D genome chromatin loops
task: Detect chromatin loops from single-cell 3D genome contact data
key_results: CellLoop integrates intra-cellular and inter-cellular contacts via density voting; improves loop detection consistency with spatial distances and reveals cell-specific loops linked to transcription and identity in mouse brain (Dip-C) and embryogenesis (HiRES)
comments: Integration with orthogonal spatial data (MERFISH, GAGE-seq) strengthens claims but validation on larger cohorts needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating inter-cellular contacts reduces noise and improves loop detection at single-cell level
hypotheses.result: CellLoop achieved improved consistency with spatial distances and compartmentalization signals

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromatin loop dynamics define spatial domains and cell subtypes
hypotheses.result: Loop integration with GAGE-seq/MERFISH redefined spatial domain functions and improved subtype delineation

title: HCCaging: a liver physiological aging-related biomarker for hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis based on transcriptome data
task: Develop aging-related biomarker signature (HCCaging) for HCC diagnosis and prognosis
key_results: HCCaging signature established across >2,000 HCC samples (16 cohorts); increased with chronological age but higher in normal liver vs tumors; elevated in early-stage tumors; ML models using HCCaging outperformed 13 other aging gene sets; single-cell analysis showed age-associated epithelial/hepatocyte enrichment with enhanced T/NK effector function despite declining infiltration
comments: Comprehensive multi-cohort analysis is robust; dual aging role (tumor-protective via T/NK plus immunosuppression) suggests complex interactions requiring functional validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aging signature predicts HCC presence and stage better than existing aging gene sets
hypotheses.result: HCCaging-based ML models achieved higher accuracy than 13 alternative aging signatures across eight cohorts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hepatic aging paradoxically enhances T/NK effector function while reducing infiltration
hypotheses.result: Single-cell analysis revealed age-associated T/NK activation despite declining cellularity; XCL1/XCL2 upregulation in aged T/NK cells

title: An international mega-analysis of psychedelic drug effects on brain circuit function
task: Conduct mega-analysis of psychedelic drug effects on brain function via resting-state fMRI
key_results: Integrated 11 fMRI datasets across five psychedelics (psilocybin, LSD, mescaline, DMT, ayahuasca) from three continents; discovered core signature: increased functional connectivity between transmodal (default, frontoparietal, limbic) and unimodal (visual, somatomotor) networks; altered subcortical (thalamus, caudate, putamen) and cerebellar coupling; weak-to-moderate within-network reductions with substantial drug/network variability
comments: Bayesian hierarchical modeling and uniform preprocessing strengthen consistency; mechanisms underlying therapeutic effects remain speculative.

inputs: 11 resting-state fMRI datasets (five psychedelics, n>500 subjects)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Psychedelics share common brain functional reorganization across drugs and sites
hypotheses.result: Bayesian modeling identified consistent transmodal-unimodal integration with drug/network-specific variability

title: Long non-coding RNA profiling of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in mice
task: Profile long non-coding RNAs in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy mouse model
key_results: RNA-Seq dataset from HCM TNNT2 Δ160 transgenic (n=31) vs non-transgenic (n=33) mice; differentially expressed lncRNAs identified; mouse lncRNA orthologs mapped to human genes
comments: Transcriptomic dataset provided but functional characterization of identified lncRNAs absent.

inputs: left ventricle tissue (HCM transgenic n=31, non-transgenic n=33)

title: Benchmarks and methods for 3D medical image retrieval
task: Establish benchmark for 3D medical image retrieval
key_results: First 3D-MIR benchmark with four anatomies (liver, colon, pancreas, lung) from CT; evaluated image-to-image and text-to-image retrieval strategies
comments: Addresses a genuine gap in medical AI evaluation, though clinical validation of retrieval efficacy is not demonstrated.

title: Development, validation, and visualization of a novel nomogram for predicting clinical outcomes of postoperative cervical cancer patients
task: Develop multimodal clinical-pathomics model for cervical cancer prognosis
key_results: TransMIL + clinical integration model achieved C-index 0.700 for OS prediction and 0.626 for DFS, outperforming pathomics-only (C-index 0.631/0.549) and clinical-only models; patients stratified into risk groups with significant survival differences
comments: Strong nested cross-validation approach but limited to single institution; external validation crucial for clinical adoption.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration of pathomics and clinical features improves prognostic accuracy over single modality
hypotheses.result: Clinical-Pathomics model achieved superior C-index for both OS and DFS prediction

title: Biobanking of vector-borne viruses in the Philippines: basic principles, best practices, and challenges
task: Establish procedural framework for vector-borne virus biobanking
key_results: VRV Biobank housed 182 serum/nucleic acid/culture samples with comprehensive SOPs; identified strengths (protocol adherence, QC integration, personnel training) and challenges (ethical compliance variation, procurement, staffing limitations)
comments: First documented virus biobank in Philippines; practical insights valuable but limited sample size and geographic scope.

title: Distinct molecular profiles associated with early vs late genome instability in cancer
task: Identify molecular features distinguishing early vs late genome instability in cancer
key_results: EGI tumors exhibit higher aneuploidy, enriched for homologous recombination deficiency (SBS3); LGI tumors show environmentally-linked signatures (UV, haloalkanes); EGI enriched in activated immune cells (mast, dendritic, NK); stemness higher in EGI
comments: VAF-based temporal inference of hallmark acquisition is novel but lacks direct experimental validation of ordering.

outputs: inferred hallmark acquisition order (EGI vs LGI)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Early vs late genome instability associates with distinct mutational processes and immune states
hypotheses.result: EGI/LGI tumors showed different mutational signatures, immune infiltration, and stemness profiles

title: Novel deep learning-based optimization framework for the classification of respiratory diseases using lung sound analysis
task: Classify respiratory diseases using deep learning optimization on lung sounds
key_results: EBiLSTM-ASBO model achieved 18.51% accuracy improvement over baselines (FFT-PCR, RFINCA, HST, RDCNN); statistically significant gains in precision/recall/MCC (p<0.05); trained on 920 recordings from ICBHI 2017 dataset
comments: Hybrid optimization strategy (ASBO) is novel but comparison with standard hyperparameter tuning methods missing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid meta-heuristic optimization improves respiratory disease classification
hypotheses.result: EBiLSTM-ASBO significantly outperformed CNN/MLP baselines with 18.51% accuracy gain

title: Smart medical system integrating clinical workflows for robust skin cancer detection across heterogeneous pathologies
task: Classify skin cancer using hybrid deep learning with attention and meta-heuristic optimization
key_results: Attention-guided autoencoder + transformer-inspired module + hybrid hyperparameter optimization (Bayesian+GWO+WOA) achieved >98% accuracy on HAM10000/ISIC-2019/ISIC-2020; improved F1-score and AUROC
comments: Comprehensive optimization framework is novel but computational cost not reported; clinical validation limited to dermoscopic images.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid optimization of attention-transformer architecture improves skin cancer classification
hypotheses.result: Proposed model exceeded 98% accuracy with superior F1-score/AUROC on benchmark datasets

title: Prediction of primary glaucoma: development and validation of multiple machine learning models
task: Develop machine learning models for primary glaucoma prediction
key_results: XGBoost model achieved AUC 0.986 (95% CI 0.974–0.995); identified 11 predictors (blood markers + retinal parameters); SHAP analysis provided feature importance visualization
comments: Strong predictive performance but limited to single-center retrospective data; prospective external validation needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining blood markers with retinal parameters improves glaucoma prediction
hypotheses.result: XGBoost model achieved superior AUC 0.986 versus individual modalities

title: Machine learning-driven drug repurposing for HER2-positive breast cancer
task: Identify HER2 inhibitors via machine learning drug repurposing
key_results: Random Forest model (R²=0.81) screened 4,099 FDA drugs; FDA0870 (Timolol maleate) ranked as top dual HER2 inhibitor with docking scores -10.5 to -7.5 kcal/mol (wild-type) and -11.6 to -8.0 kcal/mol (exon-20 mutant); MD simulations confirmed stability (RMSD <4 Å)
comments: Computational pipeline is rigorous but lacks experimental validation; in vitro/in vivo efficacy unknown.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FDA-approved drugs can be repurposed as HER2 inhibitors via ML-guided screening
hypotheses.result: FDA0870 identified as promising dual inhibitor with superior binding affinity and stability

title: Genome-wide identification and expression analysis of HMAs gene family in tobacco under abiotic stress
task: Characterize HMA gene family in tobacco under abiotic stress
